calls.video_title: Will CoreWeave Stock Investors Get Swallowed by its Debt? | CRWV Stock
calls.thesis: BUY reiterated - risk versus reward is attractive, but only for very high risk tolerance. He reiterated the buy he upgraded to on 14 Oct (and restated earlier today at ~$50): $6.5bn cash, ~$9bn of customer prepayments coming, secured debt trading near par, but capex of ~$38bn is roughly 300% of 2026 revenue.

calls.bull_case: Demand keeps outrunning capacity and the backlog converts at higher prices.
calls.bear_case: Unsecured debt repricing, hyperscalers self-building, and prepayments making contracts less attractive.

calls.video_title: Better AI Stock to Buy: Coreweave vs. IREN vs. Nebius | CRWV Stock vs. IREN Stock vs. NBIS Stock
calls.thesis: BUY — his pick as best of the three: largest revenue ($9.9bn TTM, ~5x Nebius), building data centres faster than expected, though most indebted at $65.5bn debt.
calls.base_case: All three are undervalued per his DCF but extremely risky — only for investors with very high risk tolerance.
calls.bull_case: All three are sold out of data-centre capacity into next year and beyond, with billions in backlog from customers waiting to consume the computing they bring online.
calls.bear_case: Financing is getting harder for all three — they now ask customers for billions in prepayments, which makes them less attractive; hyperscalers may build data centres themselves, and Microsoft has said it will rely less on third-party providers.

calls.thesis: BUY, first explicit Couch CRWV direction (all prior tracked CRWV entries were UNCERTAIN; no flip) — in this collaboration (byline 'The Motley Fool and 2 more', with Neil) CoreWeave is Couch's own pick for the neocloud market right now: 'that would be my pick.' He stresses the one thing he wants clarity on in earnings is future funding and debt costs.
calls.base_case: CoreWeave sits in SemiAnalysis's platinum tier for its platform, has repeatedly shown it can build AI infrastructure on time and keep GPUs running at a high pace for AI labs, and recently reported 1.5 gigawatts of active power.
calls.bull_case: It is shifting from long AI-lab contracts toward higher-margin enterprise work, has a strong Nvidia partnership, and demand/supply imbalance should last at least 18-24 months on SpaceX's commentary, with pricing still rising.
calls.bear_case: Funding is the open risk: the market fears the interest rates CoreWeave will pay on future debt, and unlike SpaceX it cannot assume sub-one-year paybacks if build-outs slip.
